## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete change and its effect.

## Requirement and compatibility

RFC/version/section, requirement IDs, affected components, and compatibility impact.
For normative changes, link the public review and decision record.

## Validation

Commands and results; clearly identify blocked or unsupported checks.
Include shared vectors or a reason none are needed.

## Contribution checklist

- [ ] I have the right to contribute under the destination path's license.
- [ ] Commits include a Signed-off-by line.
- [ ] No secrets or private data are included.
- [ ] Security and conformance claims match the evidence.
